findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "search_my_work" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "search_my_work" is 3022 chars, far longer than this server's median (334). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_my_work · Private data: search_my_work, get_task_context, get_session_excerpt, attach_session_to_task, find_coding_agent_failures, finish_session_upload, list_team_tasks · Public sink: attach_session_to_task, start_session_upload, finish_session_upload.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_my_work · Private data: search_my_work, get_task_context, get_session_excerpt, attach_session_to_task, find_coding_agent_failures, finish_session_upload, list_team_tasks · Public sink: attach_session_to_task, start_session_upload, finish_session_upload

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
